unitTitle: B1 · Make a proposal and explore what could happen
title: Dialogues
subtitle: B1 · Unit 3: B1 · Make a proposal and explore what could happen

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for each speaker's goal and the detail that changes the exchange. First read for meaning; then cover the English and summarize each person's point.

steps.title: A different meeting time
steps.body: Neighbours consider a fictional earlier meeting.

examples.fr: Plusieurs personnes arrivent après le travail.
examples.en: Nadia: Several people arrive after work.

examples.fr: Si nous commencions à dix-huit heures, davantage de voisins pourraient venir.
examples.en: Omar: If we started at six, more neighbours could come.

examples.fr: Je comprends, mais certains terminent à cette heure-là.
examples.en: Nadia: I understand, but some people finish at that time.

examples.fr: On pourrait essayer un samedi matin.
examples.en: Omar: We could try a Saturday morning.

examples.fr: Oui, si le centre confirme la salle.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes, if the centre confirms the room.

steps.title: Suggesting a trial
steps.body: Classmates discuss a limited change to a study group.

examples.fr: Le groupe en ligne convient mieux à mon horaire.
examples.en: Lina: The online group fits my schedule better.

examples.fr: Si nous gardions une séance en personne, tout le monde pourrait choisir.
examples.en: Sam: If we kept one in-person session, everyone could choose.
Lina: That would be a good compromise.

examples.fr: Il faudrait vérifier les disponibilités avant de décider.
examples.en: Sam: We would need to check availability before deciding.

examples.fr: Essayons pendant quatre semaines, puis comparons les retours.
examples.en: Lina: Let's try for four weeks, then compare the feedback.
